title: Dynamical Regime Transitions in Cosmology: A CMB-Safe Framework
abstract: Landau theory provides CMB safety through dynamical gating: G(z=1100) is approximately 1e-12 (8 orders below the 1e-4 threshold), while G(z=0) is approximately 0.9999. The gating function G(z), computed from the Landau equation via RK4 integration, ensures that regime-dependent modifications to gravity are fully suppressed at recombination and only activate at late times (z < 2), providing a CMB-consistent approach to late-time cosmological modifications.
